description: This file defines built-in commands for a code analysis or automation tool, including a command 'init' that provides detailed instructions for creating project-specific guidance documentation (AGENTS.md). It includes interfaces, a command record, and functions to retrieve commands and their metadata.

methods.name: getBuiltInCommands
methods.description: Returns an array of all built-in command objects with their details.

methods.name: getBuiltInCommand
methods.description: Retrieves a specific command object by name, if it exists.

methods.name: getBuiltInCommandNames
methods.description: Returns an array of all available built-in command names.
